cues.en: In nineteen o one, this ancient Greek artifact was discovered in a shipwreck off the island of Antikythera.
cues.zh: 1901年，人们在安提基特拉岛附近的一艘沉船中发现了这件古希腊文物。

cues.en: Three d x-ray scans have revealed it contains 37
cues.zh: 3D X射线扫描显示，它包含37个

cues.en: interlocking bronze gears, allowing it to model the motions of the sun and moon and predict eclipses decades in advance.
cues.zh: 相互咬合的青铜齿轮，能用来模拟太阳和月球的运动，并提前几十年预测日月食。

cues.en: Constructed around a 100 or 200 BC,
cues.zh: 它大约制造于公元前100到200年间，

cues.en: the Antikythera
cues.zh: 这台安提基特拉

cues.en: mechanism represents a sophisticated early computer,
cues.zh: 机械装置代表了一台极其复杂的早期计算机，

cues.en: the likes of which would not be seen again for at least a thousand years.
cues.zh: 在之后至少一千年里，类似的技术都未曾再次出现。

cues.en: Now, of course, this computer didn't work like modern digital computers.
cues.zh: 当然，这台计算机的工作原理与现代数字计算机截然不同。

cues.en: It works by analogy.
cues.zh: 它是靠模拟机制运行的。

cues.en: The gears were constructed in such a way that the motions of certain dials are analogous to the motion of the sun and moon.
cues.zh: 这些齿轮的精巧构造，使得特定指针的转动与太阳和月球的运动相对应。

cues.en: It is an analog computer.
cues.zh: 它是一台模拟计算机。

cues.en: Here is a simple analog computer for adding two numbers together. If you turn the black wheel some amount and then turn this white wheel a different amount,
cues.zh: 这是一个用于两数相加的简易模拟计算机。如果你把黑轮转动一定角度，再把白轮转动另一个角度，

cues.en: the gray wheel shows the sum of the two rotations.
cues.zh: 灰轮就会显示这两次转动角度的总和。

cues.en: In contrast,
cues.zh: 相比之下，

cues.en: this is a digital mechanical computer where you can add two single bit numbers.
cues.zh: 这是一台可以实现两个单比特相加的机械式数字计算机。

cues.en: So zero plus zero equals zero,
cues.zh: 比如 0 加 0 等于 0，

cues.en: zero plus one equals one,
cues.zh: 0 加 1 等于 1，

cues.en: and one plus one equals two.
cues.zh: 而 1 加 1 等于 2。

cues.en: These two devices
cues.zh: 这两个装置

cues.en: illustrate the differences between analog and digital computers.
cues.zh: 生动展示了模拟计算机与数字计算机的区别。

cues.en: Analog computers have a continuous range of inputs and outputs
cues.zh: 模拟计算机的输入和输出是连续变化的，

cues.en: whereas digital only works with discrete values.
cues.zh: 而数字计算机则只处理离散的数值。

cues.en: With analog computers the quantities of interest are actually represented by something physical like the amount a wheel has turned
cues.zh: 在模拟计算机中，关心的数值直接由物理量表示，比如轮子转动的幅度；

cues.en: whereas digital computers work on symbols like zeros and ones.
cues.zh: 而数字计算机则是基于 0 和 1 这样的符号来进行运算的。

cues.en: If the answer is say two,
cues.zh: 如果答案是二，

cues.en: there is nothing in the computer that is twice as much as a one. In analog computers,
cues.zh: 计算机里没有任何东西是一的两倍。在模拟计算机中，

cues.en: there is.
cues.zh: 确实有。

cues.en: For thousands of years, people used analog devices like the anti kithra mechanism or slide rules alongside digital devices like abacuses.
cues.zh: 几千年来，人们使用安提基特拉机械或计算尺等模拟设备，还有算盘等数字设备。

cues.en: And up until the nineteen sixties, the most powerful computers on the planet were actually analog.
cues.zh: 直到二十世纪六十年代，地球上最强大的计算机实际上都是模拟的。

cues.en: Digital computers exploded onto the scene with the advent of solid state transistors.
cues.zh: 随着固态晶体管的出现，数字计算机迅速崛起。

cues.en: Now, almost everything is digital. Most people have never even heard of analog computers.
cues.zh: 如今，几乎所有东西都是数字的。大多数人甚至从未听说过模拟计算机。

cues.en: But today,
cues.zh: 但今天，

cues.en: that may all be changing.
cues.zh: 这一切可能都在改变。

cues.en: Moore's law, the idea that you can double the number of transistors on a chip every two years, it's reaching its limit because transistors are nearly the same size as atoms.
cues.zh: 摩尔定律，即每两年可以将芯片上的晶体管数量翻一番，它正接近极限，因为晶体管的尺寸已几乎与原子相同。

cues.en: Simultaneously,
cues.zh: 同时，

cues.en: advancements in machine learning are straining the capabilities of digital computers.
cues.zh: 机器学习的进步正在给数字计算机的能力带来压力。

cues.en: The solution to these challenges may well be a new generation
cues.zh: 这些挑战的解决方案很可能就是新一代

cues.en: of analog computers.
cues.zh: 的模拟计算机。

cues.en: One of the most important problems humans have faced for millennia is predicting the tides.
cues.zh: 人类几千年来面临的最重要问题之一是预测潮汐。

cues.en: Napoleon and his men nearly died crossing the Red Sea due to a miscalculation
cues.zh: 拿破仑和他的部下因误算涨潮而差点死在红海，

cues.en: of the rising tide.
cues.zh: 不断上涨的浪潮。

cues.en: And sailors routinely needed to know the tides to bring their ships into port without running aground.
cues.zh: 水手们经常需要了解潮汐才能将船安全驶入港口而不搁浅。

cues.en: Most coastal locations on Earth experienced
cues.zh: 地球上大多数沿海地点每天经历

cues.en: too high and too low tides per day,
cues.zh: 过高和过低的潮汐，

cues.en: but their exact timing varies as does their magnitude.
cues.zh: 但它们的确切时间各不相同，幅度也不同。

cues.en: And this is partly caused by local factors like the depth of the seabed and the shape of the shoreline.
cues.zh: 而这部分是由海底深度和海岸线形状等局部因素造成的。

cues.en: In the late seventeen hundreds, to describe the tidal flow of the oceans,
cues.zh: 在17世纪末，为了描述海洋的潮汐流动，

cues.en: Pierre Simon Laplace derived a set of complicated differential equations.
cues.zh: 皮埃尔·西蒙·拉普拉斯推导出了一组复杂的微分方程。

cues.en: They had no analytical solution, so at the time they were basically useless.
cues.zh: 这些方程没有解析解，所以在当时基本上没什么用。

cues.en: But in the process of deriving his equations, Laplace made a key finding.
cues.zh: 但在推导方程的过程中，拉普拉斯有一个关键发现。

cues.en: Tides are driven at only a few specific astronomical
cues.zh: 潮汐只由几个特定的天文

cues.en: frequencies,
cues.zh: 频率驱动，

cues.en: including the moon,
cues.zh: 包括月球、

cues.en: the sun,
cues.zh: 太阳，

cues.en: and the eccentricity
cues.zh: 以及月球轨道的

cues.en: of the lunar orbit.
cues.zh: 偏心率。

cues.en: Each one of these factors contributes a sine wave of a particular amplitude and phase to the total tide curve.
cues.zh: 这些因素每一个都以特定振幅和相位的正弦波形式，对总潮汐曲线做出贡献。

cues.en: If someone could figure out how to correctly combine these frequency components,
cues.zh: 如果有人能弄清楚如何正确组合这些频率分量，

cues.en: well, the tides could finally be predicted.
cues.zh: 那么潮汐终于可以被预测了。

cues.en: It took nearly a century, but in the eighteen sixties,
cues.zh: 这花了近一个世纪，但到了19世纪60年代，

cues.en: William Thompson,
cues.zh: 威廉·汤姆森，

cues.en: later Lord Kelvin,
cues.zh: 后来的开尔文勋爵，

cues.en: took up the challenge. Having completed several voyages to lay the first Transatlantic telegraph cable, he developed a fascination with the sea. And subsequently, he threw his full scientific effort into measuring and predicting the tides.
cues.zh: 接下了这个挑战。在完成了几次铺设第一条跨大西洋电报电缆的航行后，他对海洋产生了浓厚兴趣。随后，他将全部科学精力投入到测量和预测潮汐中。

cues.en: Tide gauges at the time used a buoy to record the height of the sea onto a paper roll.
cues.zh: 当时的潮汐计用一个浮标把海面高度记录到纸卷上。

cues.en: Kelvin set out to determine how sine waves with the frequencies identified by Laplace
cues.zh: 开尔文着手确定，具有拉普拉斯所识别频率的正弦波

cues.en: could add together to produce the observed tidal curve.
cues.zh: 如何叠加在一起，从而产生观测到的潮汐曲线。

cues.en: The key was to apply the work of French mathematician, Joseph Fourier, who had shown how to decompose any function into a sum of sine waves.
cues.zh: 关键在于应用法国数学家约瑟夫·傅里叶的研究成果，他展示了如何将任何函数分解为正弦波之和。

cues.en: Most English scientists were skeptical of the work, but Thompson was enthralled by it. His first paper published at 17
cues.zh: 大多数英国科学家对此持怀疑态度，但汤普森却为之着迷。他的第一篇论文发表于17岁

cues.en: was a defense of Fourier.
cues.zh: 是为傅里叶辩护的。

cues.en: While it was straightforward to apply Fourier's analysis to tidal curves, the computation required was enormous.
cues.zh: 虽然将傅里叶分析应用于潮汐曲线很直接，但所需的计算量极其庞大。

cues.en: First, divide the tide curve up into short time intervals.
cues.zh: 首先，将潮汐曲线划分为短时间间隔。

cues.en: And for each interval, multiply the tide level by a sine wave the frequency of interest.
cues.zh: 对于每个间隔，将潮汐高度乘以感兴趣频率的正弦波。

cues.en: Add up the area of all these rectangles and divide by the total time.
cues.zh: 将所有矩形的面积相加，再除以总时间。

cues.en: And this gives you a single coefficient,
cues.zh: 这就得到了一个系数，

cues.en: the amplitude of the sine wave with this frequency.
cues.zh: 即该频率正弦波的振幅。

cues.en: Then you have to repeat the process for a cosine function with the same frequency.
cues.zh: 然后，你必须对相同频率的余弦函数重复这个过程。

cues.en: Kelvin found that to make accurate predictions,
cues.zh: 开尔文发现，为了做出准确的预测，

cues.en: he actually needed 10 different frequency components.
cues.zh: 他实际上需要10个不同的频率分量。

cues.en: So that is a lot of multiplication and addition to characterize the tides at just one location.
cues.zh: 因此，仅表征一个地点的潮汐就需要大量的乘法和加法运算。

cues.en: For each additional location, you have to perform this analysis all over again.
cues.zh: 对于每个额外的地点，你必须重新进行整个分析。

cues.en: And this is only half the problem.
cues.zh: 而这只是问题的一半。

cues.en: Once you have the amplitudes and phases of the sine functions, you have to add them up to predict future tides.
cues.zh: 一旦你得到了正弦函数的振幅和相位，你必须将它们相加来预测未来的潮汐。

cues.en: Lord Calvin spent years analyzing and predicting tides by hand.
cues.zh: 开尔文勋爵花了数年时间手工分析和预测潮汐。

cues.en: Then he had a stroke of inspiration.
cues.zh: 然后他灵光一现。

cues.en: Could you design a machine to carry out these calculations automatically?
cues.zh: 你能设计一台机器来自动完成这些计算吗？

cues.en: In Kelvin's words, to substitute brass for brains.
cues.zh: 用 Kelvin 的话说，就是用黄铜代替大脑。

cues.en: The resulting analog computers were in use for nearly a century.
cues.zh: 由此造出的模拟计算机使用了近一个世纪。

cues.en: They even played a critical role in the outcome of World War two.
cues.zh: 它们甚至在二战的结局中发挥了关键作用。

cues.en: Kelvin started with the problem of prediction, adding the sine waves together given you know their amplitudes and phases.
cues.zh: Kelvin 从预测问题入手：在已知振幅和相位的情况下，把正弦波相加。

cues.en: He knew he could create sinusoidal motion with a device called a Scotch yoke. It extracts one dimension from uniform circular motion.
cues.zh: 他知道可以用一种叫苏格兰轭的装置产生正弦运动。它从匀速圆周运动中提取一个维度。

cues.en: But to make a tide prediction, he needed a way to combine 10 sine waves together.
cues.zh: 但要做潮汐预测，他需要一种把 10 个正弦波组合起来的方法。

cues.en: He needed a mechanical analog for addition.
cues.zh: 他需要一种用于加法的机械模拟装置。

cues.en: Stuck on this problem in 1872,
cues.zh: 1872 年，他正被这个问题困住，

cues.en: Calvin boarded a train for a meeting with the main sponsor of his title research, the British Association.
cues.zh: Kelvin 乘火车去参加一场会议，会见他的潮汐研究的主要资助方 British Association。

cues.en: On the train, Calvin bumped into a friend, inventor Beauchamp Tower, to whom he explained his dilemma.
cues.zh: 在火车上，Kelvin 偶遇朋友、发明家 Beauchamp Tower，并向他解释了自己的困境。

cues.en: Tower suggested he use Wheatstone's plan of a chain passing around a number of pulleys.
cues.zh: Tower 建议他采用 Wheatstone 的方案：让一条链条绕过若干滑轮。

cues.en: And this was exactly the addition mechanism Calvin was looking for. By attaching a pulley to each Scotch yoke and running a weighted cord around them, he could mechanically add all of their contributions at once.
cues.zh: 这正是 Kelvin 要找的加法机构。给每个苏格兰轭装一个滑轮，再让一根配重绳绕过它们，他就能一次性机械地把它们的所有分量相加。

cues.en: He scribbled down the entire plan for this predictor machine by the end of the train ride. He pitched it to the British Association and secured funding to build it all before he returned home.
cues.zh: 火车旅程结束时，他已经匆匆写下了这台预测机的完整方案。他向 British Association 推介了它，并在回家前就争取到了建造整台机器的资金。

cues.en: If you knew the relative contributions of different frequency components,
cues.zh: 如果你知道不同频率成分的相对贡献，

cues.en: Kelvin now had a machine to automate the tedious task of predicting future tides.
cues.zh: 开尔文现在有了一台机器，可以自动化预测未来潮汐这项繁琐的任务。

cues.en: This was a great leap forward.
cues.zh: 这是一次巨大的飞跃。

cues.en: Four hours of cranking the handle yielded a full year of tidal predictions.
cues.zh: 摇动手柄四个小时，就能得到一整年的潮汐预测。

cues.en: But for many years, the harder half of the problem was still done by hand,
cues.zh: 但很多年里，问题中更困难的那一半仍然靠手工完成，

cues.en: breaking apart an existing tide curve into its component frequencies.
cues.zh: 就是把现有的潮汐曲线分解成各个频率成分。

cues.en: To automate this step, Calvin needed a machine capable of multiplying the tide curve times a sine wave and then taking its integral.
cues.zh: 为了自动化这一步，开尔文需要一台机器，能够把潮汐曲线乘以正弦波，然后求积分。

cues.en: What would such a device even look like?
cues.zh: 这样的装置会是什么样子呢？

cues.en: With his older brother, James Thompson, Calvin came up with a mechanical integrator.
cues.zh: 开尔文和他的哥哥詹姆斯·汤姆森一起想出了一个机械积分器。

cues.en: It consists of a ball on a rotating disc.
cues.zh: 它由一个放在旋转圆盘上的球组成。

cues.en: Due to the rotation of the disc, the further the ball is from the center, the faster it spins.
cues.zh: 由于圆盘的旋转，球离中心越远，转得就越快。

cues.en: If the ball is at the very center of the disc, it doesn't turn at all. And if it's on the left side, it turns in the opposite direction.
cues.zh: 如果球在圆盘的正中心，它根本不会转。如果它在左侧，就会朝相反方向转。

cues.en: Now, the motion of the ball is converted into an output via a roller, which moves a pen up or down on the output graph paper.
cues.zh: 然后，球的运动通过一个滚轮转换成输出，滚轮让笔在输出图纸上上下移动。

cues.en: So the way it works is you trace the function you wanna integrate with a stylus,
cues.zh: 所以它的工作方式是：你用触笔描摹想要积分的函数，

cues.en: and the stylus controls the position of the ball on the disc, and hence its speed of rotation.
cues.zh: 触笔控制球在圆盘上的位置，从而控制它的旋转速度。

cues.en: This is transferred through the roller to the output, which plots the integral of the original function.
cues.zh: 这个运动通过滚轮传递到输出端，输出端就绘出原函数的积分。

cues.en: Now to decompose a tide curve, we don't just wanna integrate the function. We first wanna multiply it by a sine wave of a particular frequency.
cues.zh: 现在要分解潮汐曲线，不能只对函数积分。首先要把它乘以某一频率的正弦波。

cues.en: And the way to do this is to make the disc rotate back and forth at that specific frequency.
cues.zh: 方法就是让圆盘以该特定频率来回转动。

cues.en: Now the rotation of the ball depends not only on where it is on the disc, but also on how the disc is turning at that instant.
cues.zh: 球的转动不仅取决于它在圆盘上的位置，还取决于圆盘那一刻的转动方式。

cues.en: You trace the tide curve with the stylus, which moves the ball back and forth on the oscillating disc, and the roller sums up the integral of the tide curve times the sine wave.
cues.zh: 用触针描摹潮汐曲线，带动球在振荡的圆盘上前后移动，滚轮则累加潮汐曲线乘以正弦波后的积分。

cues.en: Simply divide by the total time to get the coefficient.
cues.zh: 再除以总时间，就得到系数。

cues.en: Several of these ball and disk integrators can be connected in parallel with each disk oscillating at a different frequency
cues.zh: 可以把多个这样的球盘积分器并联，每个圆盘以不同频率振荡，

cues.en: to calculate the coefficients for multiple frequency components at the same time.
cues.zh: 从而同时计算多个频率分量的系数。

cues.en: Kelvin's analog computers
cues.zh: 开尔文的模拟计算机

cues.en: revolutionized
cues.zh: 彻底革新了

cues.en: our ability to predict tides.
cues.zh: 我们预测潮汐的能力。

cues.en: Tidal curves from anywhere in the world could be turned into a set of sinusoidal coefficients using the ball and disk harmonic analyzer,
cues.zh: 世界各地的潮汐曲线，都能用球盘谐波分析仪转换为一组正弦系数，

cues.en: And the resulting sinusoids could be added together to predict future tides using his Scotch yoke pulley machine.
cues.zh: 再用他的苏格兰轭滑轮机把得到的正弦波相加，就能预测未来的潮汐。

cues.en: Kelvin's harmonic analyzers were the basis for a landmark analog computer called the differential analyzer,
cues.zh: 开尔文的谐波分析仪为一部里程碑式的模拟计算机——微分分析仪——奠定了基础，

cues.en: and his tide predicting machines were used well into the nineteen sixties.
cues.zh: 他的潮汐预测机一直使用到20世纪60年代后期。

cues.en: In fact, they were later overhauled to include 26 frequency components and used to plan the allied invasion on d day.
cues.zh: 事实上，它们后来经过改造，纳入26个频率分量，并被用于策划盟军D日登陆。

cues.en: The Germans expected any invasion to come at high tide to minimize the time Allied soldiers would be exposed on the beaches.
cues.zh: 德国人预计任何入侵都会在高潮时到来，以尽量减少盟军士兵在海滩上暴露的时间。

cues.en: So they installed millions of obstacles that would be underwater by mid tide, many with explosive mines attached.
cues.zh: 因此他们布设了数百万个障碍物，这些障碍物在中等潮位时会被淹没，其中许多还装有爆炸性地雷。

cues.en: But the allies spotted the obstacles and changed tack.
cues.zh: 但盟军发现了这些障碍物，并改变了策略。

cues.en: Instead, they planned to begin the invasion at low tide. This would allow demolition teams to first clear channels through the obstacles.
cues.zh: 他们改为计划在低潮时开始入侵。这样拆除小队就能先清出穿过障碍物的通道。

cues.en: Then the main forces could come through those gaps as the water rose.
cues.zh: 然后主力部队可以在水位上涨时通过这些缺口进入。

cues.en: This would also give landing craft enough time to depart without getting beached.
cues.zh: 这也能给登陆艇足够的时间撤离，而不会被搁浅。

cues.en: The low water times were different at the five landing beaches by over an hour. So the invasion times were staggered according to the tide predictions.
cues.zh: 五个登陆海滩的低潮时间相差超过一小时。因此入侵时间根据潮汐预测进行了错开。

cues.en: This wasn't the only use of analog computers in World War two. Dive bomber aircraft would plummet out of the sky directly toward their targets at up to an 80 degree angle,
cues.zh: 这并不是模拟计算机在二战中的唯一用途。俯冲轰炸机会以高达80度的角度直接从空中俯冲向目标，

cues.en: and their rapid descents made them very difficult to shoot down. So The US began searching for devices to automatically aim guns at dive bombers.
cues.zh: 它们快速下降，使它们很难被击落。于是美国开始寻找能自动瞄准俯冲轰炸机的装置。

cues.en: Most of the proposed solutions fell into one of two categories.
cues.zh: 大多数提出的解决方案都归入两类之一。

cues.en: Some were analog machines like Lord Kelvin's,
cues.zh: 一些是像开尔文勋爵那样的模拟机器，

cues.en: others were essentially fast calculators.
cues.zh: 另一些本质上是快速计算器。

cues.en: Mechanical calculating machines like the Abacus had been around for millennia, but they were far too slow to respond to dive bombers.
cues.zh: 像算盘这样的机械计算器已经存在了几千年，但它们反应太慢，无法应对俯冲轰炸机。

cues.en: These new calculating machines sped things up by using electrical pulses.
cues.zh: 这些新型计算机器通过使用电脉冲提高了运算速度。

cues.en: The committee considered naming these devices after the pulses they used, but member George Stibits proposed a more general name, digital,
cues.zh: 委员会曾考虑根据这些设备使用的电脉冲来命名，但成员 George Stibits 提出了一个更通用的名称：digital（数字）。

cues.en: because these machines operated on numbers themselves or digits.
cues.zh: 因为这些机器直接处理的是数字本身，也就是数位。

cues.en: And this is the origin of the term digital computer.
cues.zh: 这就是“数字计算机”一词的由来。

cues.en: But digital would have to wait. Of all the proposals, an innovative analog machine from David Parkinson won out.
cues.zh: 不过，digital 这个名称还得再等等。在所有提案中，David Parkinson 提出的一种创新型模拟机器最终胜出。

cues.en: At Bell Labs in New York, Parkinson had been working on a device to chart telephone data called an automatic level recorder.
cues.zh: 在纽约的 Bell Labs，Parkinson 一直在研发一种用于绘制电话数据图表的设备，名为自动电平记录仪。

cues.en: It used a variable resistor called a potentiometer to control the motion of a pen.
cues.zh: 它使用一种叫作电位器的可变电阻来控制笔的移动。

cues.en: One night, after hearing reports of the harrowing allied evacuation of Dunkirk,
cues.zh: 一天晚上，听闻盟军从敦刻尔克惊险撤离的消息后，

cues.en: Parkinson had a dream that he was on the front lines.
cues.zh: Parkinson 梦见自己置身前线。

cues.en: I found myself in a gun pit with an anti aircraft gun crew.
cues.zh: 我发现自己身处一个炮位，旁边是一支高射炮小组。

cues.en: A gun there was firing occasionally and the impressive thing was that every shot brought down an airplane.
cues.zh: 那里有一门炮不时开火，令人惊叹的是，每一发炮弹都能击落一架飞机。

cues.en: After three or four shots, one of the men in the crew smiled at me and beckoned me to come closer to the gun. When I drew near, he pointed to the exposed end of the left trunnion.
cues.zh: 开了三四炮后，小组里有个人冲我笑了笑，招手让我靠近那门炮。我走近后，他指着左侧炮耳轴裸露的一端。

cues.en: Mounted there was the control potentiometer
cues.zh: 那里安装着一个控制电位器，

cues.en: of my level recorder.
cues.zh: 正是我那台电平记录仪上的那个。

cues.en: When he woke up, Parkinson realized the device he was building to control a pen could be scaled up to control an anti aircraft gun.
cues.zh: 醒来后，Parkinson 意识到，自己正在研发的、用于控制笔移动的设备，其实可以放大规模，用来控制一门高射炮。

cues.en: He shared this idea with his supervisor and after receiving approval from the military,
cues.zh: 他把这个想法告诉了他的主管，在获得军方批准后，

cues.en: they set out to make Parkinson's dream a reality.
cues.zh: 他们开始着手将帕金森的梦想变为现实。

cues.en: Researchers at Bell Labs had recently invented an analog electrical device called an operational amplifier or op amp. It could perform mathematical
cues.zh: 贝尔实验室的研究人员最近发明了一种模拟电子器件，叫做运算放大器，简称运放。它能对电压执行数学

cues.en: operations with voltages like addition and multiplication.
cues.zh: 运算，比如加法和乘法。

cues.en: They used these op amps to create an analog computer that could solve the ballistics equations for anti aircraft guns.
cues.zh: 他们用这些运放造出了一台模拟计算机，可以求解高射炮的弹道方程。

cues.en: Using radar and optical sites to obtain the speed, altitude, and direction of enemy planes, the m nine gun director, as the computer was called, could rapidly calculate the correct trajectory and fuse setting.
cues.zh: 利用雷达和光学瞄准装置获取敌机的速度、高度和方向，这台被称为M9射击指挥仪的计算机能快速算出正确的弹道和引信设定。

cues.en: Potentiometers
cues.zh: 电位器

cues.en: were used to ascertain the direction the gun was pointing.
cues.zh: 被用来确定火炮的指向。

cues.en: This was not the first electric analog computer, but it was an important one.
cues.zh: 这并非第一台电子模拟计算机，但它意义重大。

cues.en: In World War one, it took an average of 17,000
cues.zh: 一战时，平均需要17000

cues.en: rounds to take down a single airplane.
cues.zh: 发炮弹才能击落一架飞机。

cues.en: after the invention of the m nine, it took an average of only 90.
cues.zh: 在M9发明之后，平均只需要90发。

cues.en: During the war, The US invested
cues.zh: 战争期间，美国在模拟计算机上

cues.en: big in analog computers.
cues.zh: 投入巨大。

cues.en: If you break down their total military budget, the third largest single expense was the development and production of an incredibly complex mechanical analog computer called the Norden bombsight. Unfortunately,
cues.zh: 如果拆解他们的总军事预算，第三大单项开支就是研发和生产一台极其复杂的机械模拟计算机——诺顿轰炸瞄准器。遗憾的是，

cues.en: they didn't get their money's worth.
cues.zh: 这笔钱花得不值。

cues.en: Designed by the eccentric Dutch engineer, Karl Norden, the Norden bombsight was built to enable high precision airborne bombing. It implemented 64
cues.zh: 诺顿轰炸瞄准器由古怪的荷兰工程师卡尔·诺顿设计，旨在实现高精度空中轰炸。它同时

cues.en: different simultaneous algorithms,
cues.zh: 实现了64种不同的算法，

cues.en: including one that compensated for the rotation of the earth as the bomb fell.
cues.zh: 其中一种还能补偿炸弹下落过程中地球的自转。

cues.en: The Norden was one of the most closely guarded secrets of the war.
cues.zh: Norden 是那场战争中最严加保守的机密之一。

cues.en: To prevent the technology from falling into enemy hands, American bombardiers
cues.zh: 为了防止这项技术落入敌人之手，美国投弹员

cues.en: carried handguns specifically to destroy it in the event of a crash.
cues.zh: 随身携带手枪，专门用于在坠机时摧毁它。

cues.en: But despite its hype and funding, the Norden didn't work as advertised.
cues.zh: 但尽管备受吹捧并获得资金，Norden 并未像宣传的那样奏效。

cues.en: With over 2,000 fine parts, it required extreme precision to manufacture.
cues.zh: 它有两千多个精密零件，制造需要极高精度。

cues.en: The problem with analog computers is that the physical device is a model for the real world. So any inaccuracy in the components translates into inaccuracy of the computation. And
cues.zh: 模拟计算机的问题在于，物理装置是真实世界的模型。因此，元件的任何误差都会转化为计算误差。而且

cues.en: since there will always be some slop in the connections between parts,
cues.zh: 由于零件之间的连接总会有一些间隙，

cues.en: if you run the same calculation twice,
cues.zh: 如果你把同一计算运行两次，

cues.en: you won't get the exact same answer.
cues.zh: 得到的答案不会完全一样。

cues.en: In the American campaign against Japan, bomber crews using the bomb site were unable to destroy critical Japanese war infrastructure.
cues.zh: 在美国对日作战中，使用该瞄准具的轰炸机机组未能摧毁关键的日本战争基础设施。

cues.en: And, ultimately, The US abandoned its precision bombing approach and instead blanketed whole Japanese cities in napalm.
cues.zh: 最终，美国放弃了精确轰炸策略，转而用凝固汽油弹覆盖一座座日本城市。

cues.en: As the war progressed, digital computers gained traction.
cues.zh: 随着战争推进，数字计算机开始兴起。

cues.en: The digital and electronic colossus machines of Bletchley Park in The UK were critical to breaking German codes.
cues.zh: 英国 Bletchley Park 的数字电子 Colossus 机器，对破解德国密码至关重要。

cues.en: In The United States, the military invested in an enormously complex and expensive digital machine known as ENIAC.
cues.zh: 在美国，军方投资了一台极其复杂且昂贵的数字机器，称为 ENIAC。

cues.en: It was designed to speed up the calculation of land artillery firing tables.
cues.zh: 它旨在加速地面火炮射表的计算。

cues.en: At the time, these were computed using differential analyzers,
cues.zh: 当时，这些射表是用微分分析仪计算的，

cues.en: the analog mechanical computers based on Kelvin's harmonic analyzer.
cues.zh: 即基于 Kelvin 谐波分析仪的模拟机械计算机。

cues.en: Although not finished until after the war, ENIAC demonstrated the power of digital computers.
cues.zh: 虽然直到战后才完成，ENIAC 仍展示了数字计算机的威力。

cues.en: It's considered by many to be the first modern computer.
cues.zh: 许多人认为它是第一台现代计算机。

cues.en: What really opened the door to this digital revolution was the discovery made by Claude Shannon in his 1936 master's thesis.
cues.zh: 真正为这场数字革命打开大门的是 Claude Shannon 在 1936 年硕士论文中的发现。

cues.en: He showed that any numerical operation can be carried out using the basic building blocks of boolean algebra.
cues.zh: 他证明，任何数值运算都可以用布尔代数的基本构件来完成。

cues.en: Two values, true or false, also notated as one or zero,
cues.zh: 两个值，真或假，也记作 1 或 0，

cues.en: and three operations,
cues.zh: 以及三种运算，

cues.en: and, or, and not.
cues.zh: 与、或、非。

cues.en: This makes digital computers the ideal versatile computing machines.
cues.zh: 这使数字计算机成为理想的多用途计算机。

cues.en: In contrast, each analog computer is an analog for only one type of problem.
cues.zh: 相比之下，每台模拟计算机只能模拟一类问题。

cues.en: Furthermore, since digital computers operate on ones and zeros, they are more resilient in the face of noise.
cues.zh: 此外，由于数字计算机以 1 和 0 运行，它们面对噪声时更有韧性。

cues.en: It would take a large error to mistake a one for a zero or vice versa, Whereas even small errors in analog computers can grow and ultimately swamp the signal.
cues.zh: 要把 1 误认成 0 或反过来，需要很大的误差；而在模拟计算机中，即使很小的误差也可能增长，最终淹没信号。

cues.en: So these days, everything is digital. Our phones, computers, and Internet data centers, even TV and radio is now being broadcast as digital. The advantages are obvious.
cues.zh: 所以如今一切都是数字的。我们的手机、计算机和互联网数据中心，甚至电视和无线电现在都以数字方式广播。优势显而易见。

cues.en: Since digital devices operate on symbols,
cues.zh: 由于数字设备基于符号运行，

cues.en: usually zeros and ones, they provide exact answers
cues.zh: 通常是 0 和 1，它们能给出精确答案

cues.en: and repeat the calculation and you get the same result.
cues.zh: 重复计算也会得到相同结果。

cues.en: They are robust to noise.
cues.zh: 它们对噪声具有鲁棒性。

cues.en: Plus, since only a few components are required to perform virtually any computation,
cues.zh: 另外，由于执行几乎任何计算都只需要少量组件，

cues.en: those components have been miniaturized and optimized,
cues.zh: 这些组件已被小型化并优化，

cues.en: making digital computers the ideal universal computing machines.
cues.zh: 使数字计算机成为理想的通用计算机器。

cues.en: So you would think analog computers would be long gone, a relic of the distant past,
cues.zh: 所以你会觉得模拟计算机早就该消失了，成了遥远过去的遗迹，

cues.en: but
cues.zh: 但是

cues.en: analog may now be making a comeback.
cues.zh: 模拟计算现在可能正在卷土重来。

cues.en: There are startups
cues.zh: 有一些初创公司

cues.en: actively working on analog computers.
cues.zh: 正在积极研发模拟计算机。

cues.en: Why is this happening? What could be the benefit of analog?
cues.zh: 为什么会这样？模拟计算有什么好处呢？

cues.en: I wanted to put all of this into one video,
cues.zh: 我想把这一切浓缩成一个视频，

cues.en: but the story is too good to bury twenty minutes in. So that is coming up in part two. Be sure you're subscribed to the channel to be notified when that comes out.
cues.zh: 但这个故事太精彩了，放在二十分钟之后讲太浪费了。所以这些内容会在下集呈现。请务必订阅本频道，以便在更新时收到通知。

cues.zh: 为了看懂本视频的下集，最好先复习一下人工智能，
